名称.日文: 真岡鐵道モオカ14形気動車

日文.词条标题: 真岡鐵道モオカ14形気動車
日文.首段: 真岡鐵道モオカ14形気動車（もおかてつどうモオカ14がたきどうしゃ）は、2002年（平成14年）に営業運転を開始した真岡鐵道の気動車である。

章节.概要:
真岡鐵道開業時から使用してきたモオカ63形は、富士重工業（現：SUBARU）によるLE-CarIIシリーズであり、鉄道車両に比べて耐用年数の短いバス部品を多用していたこともあり、経年による老朽化が目立ち始めていた。
本系列はモオカ63形の置換え用として2002年（平成14年）から製作が開始され、2006年（平成18年）までに9両が増備された。形式の「14」は平成14年に登場したことにちなむ。
1・2のみ富士重工業で製造されたが、同社は2003年（平成15年）に鉄道車両事業から撤退したため、3以降は日本車輌製造で製造された。
章节.車体:
車体は富士重工業のLE-DCの仕様を踏襲しつつ、側面中央部に連窓風の固定窓を並べたり、屋根構体の曲率を1種類にしたり、前面窓の曲面ガラスを廃止するなど、より低価格化を目指した前面貫通扉付・18 m級2扉の普通鋼製となっている。日本車輌製の構体は、外板の板厚を増し、骨を減らす構造とすることで、コストを下げるとともに気動車特有の振動と騒音低減を図っている。
前面上部には前照灯・尾灯を、前面窓両側にはワンマン運転用のバックミラーを装備している。
塗装は、カバンをイメージした上部が濃淡の緑のモザイク模様（市松模様風。布地をイメージ）で、下部が橙色、さらに橙色塗装（皮革をイメージ）の上部に縫い目（ステッチ）を模した白の細帯（破線）が巻かれている。一般から募集した案を基に決定された。
章节.室内:
冷房吹出口は従来のLE-DCとは異なり、コストダウンを目指して連続したグリルとなっている。

座席はセミクロスシート（富士重工製）またはオールロングシート（日本車輌製）で、運転台後部にデジタル運賃表示機と両替機付き料金箱、整理券発行機を設置している。
章节.機器類:
走行機器類は地元のメーカー製に統一しており、走行用機関として小松製作所製のディーゼルエンジンSA6D125-H-1（355 ps）を1基、変速機も同社製のKTF3335Aを搭載している。台車はボルスタレス台車のFU56D/Tを履いている。また暖房はエンジンの冷却水を利用した温風式である。

モオカ14-1および2にはJR線乗り入れに備えATS-Pが搭載されたが、使用実績はなく、3以降は搭載されていない。
章节.製造メーカーによる差異:
富士重工製の2両は室内側から容易に電球を交換出来るようにするため、前照灯・標識灯は貫通扉上に集中配置となっているが、日本車輌製の7両は左右の前面窓上に分けて配置されており、貫通扉上部は「ワンマン灯」用の小窓となっている。
このほか、富士重工製の2両はコストダウンのために前面下部のステップが鉄棒で作られた簡易なもののみ（後年その上部に別のステップを増設）であったり、側面の雨どいが外部に露出しているなどの差異がある。

2002年（平成14年）1月20日のモオカ14-1・2運転開始の際は、車内放送装置の故障や空調系のトラブルのほか、電気系統や制御系統など度重なるトラブルのため、昼間のみの限定運用とされ、一時は富士重工の担当者が添乗していた。
章节.運用: 2016年（平成28年）11月現在9両が在籍し、真岡線下館駅 - 茂木駅間の全線で運用されている。通常は1両での運行（単行）だが、平日の通勤通学時間帯には2両に増結される場合がある。また、真岡市夏祭大花火大会開催時は3両編成で運行される。
章节.関連項目:
富士重工業
日本車輌製造
松浦鉄道MR-600形気動車 - 本形式の2次車をベースとしており、同じく日本車輌製でほぼ同形態となっている。

中文.词条标题: 真冈铁道モオカ14型柴油动车组
中文.首段: 真冈铁道モオカ14型柴油动车组（もおかてつどうモオカ14がたきどうしゃ）是2002年（平成14年）开始商业运行的、真冈铁道的柴油动车组。

章节.概要:
自真冈铁道开业时起一直使用的モオカ63型，是富士重工业（现：SUBARU）的LE-CarII系列，由于大量使用了相比铁道车辆耐用年数较短的巴士部件，随年岁增长的老化开始明显。
本系列作为モオカ63型的替换用，从2002年（平成14年）开始制作，到2006年（平成18年）为止增备了9辆。型号中的“14”源自于平成14年登场。
仅1、2由富士重工业制造，但该公司于2003年（平成15年）从铁道车辆业务撤退，因此3以后由日本车辆制造制造。
章节.车体:
车体沿袭富士重工业LE-DC的规格，同时在侧面中央部排列连窗风的固定窗、将车顶结构体的曲率统一为一种、废除前面窗的曲面玻璃等，旨在进一步降低价格，为带前面贯通门、18 m级的双门普通钢制车。日本车辆制造的结构体通过增加外板板厚、减少骨架的结构，在降低成本的同时，力求降低柴油动车组特有的振动与噪声。
前面上部装有前照灯、尾灯，前面窗两侧装有单人运转用的后视镜。
涂装为：上部表现包袋、由深浅绿色组成的马赛克花纹（方格花纹风。象征布料），下部为橙色，并在橙色涂装（象征皮革）上部缠绕模仿缝线（针脚）的白色细带（虚线）。该方案基于从一般公众征集的设计决定。
章节.室内:
冷气吹出口与以往的LE-DC不同，为追求降低成本而做成连续的通风格栅。
座席为半交叉式座椅（富士重工制）或全纵向座椅（日本车辆制），在驾驶台后部设置数字票价显示器和带兑换机的收费箱、整理券发行机。
章节.机器类:
行驶机器类统一为当地厂家制造，作为行驶用发动机搭载1台小松制作所制造的柴油发动机SA6D125-H-1（355 ps），变速机也搭载同公司制造的KTF3335A。转向架为无摇枕转向架的FU56D/T。此外，暖气为利用发动机冷却水的热风式。
モオカ14-1及2为备用于直通JR线而搭载了ATS-P，但没有使用实绩，3以后未搭载。
章节.制造厂家造成的差异:
富士重工制的2辆为了能从室内侧容易地更换灯泡，将前照灯、标志灯集中配置在贯通门上方；而日本车辆制的7辆则分开配置在左右前面窗上方，贯通门上部成为“单人运转灯”用的小窗。
此外，富士重工制的2辆为降低成本，前面下部的踏板仅为用铁棒制成的简易之物（后来在其上部增设了另一踏板），侧面的雨水槽暴露在外部等，存在这些差异。
2002年（平成14年）1月20日モオカ14-1、2开始运行时，由于车内广播装置故障、空调系统故障，以及电气系统、控制系统等反复出现故障，被限定为仅白天运用，一时还由富士重工的相关人员添乘。
章节.运用: 2016年（平成28年）11月现在在籍9辆，在真冈线下馆站～茂木站间全线运用。通常为1辆运行（单行），但平日的通勤通学时段有时会增结为2辆。此外，在真冈市夏祭大烟花大会举办时以3辆编组运行。
章节.相关项目:
富士重工业
日本车辆制造
松浦铁道MR-600型柴油动车组 - 以本型的2次车为基础，同样由日本车辆制造，形态几乎相同。

英文.词条标题: Mooka Railway Mooka 14 series diesel railcar
英文.首段: The Mooka Railway Mooka 14 series diesel railcar (もおかてつどうモオカ14がたきどうしゃ) is a diesel railcar of Mooka Railway that began commercial operation in 2002 (Heisei 14).

章节.Overview:
The Mooka 63 series used since Mooka Railway opened was the LE-Car II series by Fuji Heavy Industries (now SUBARU), and because it made heavy use of bus parts with a shorter service life than railway vehicles, its aging with the passage of years had begun to stand out.
This series began to be produced from 2002 (Heisei 14) as a replacement for the Mooka 63 series, and by 2006 (Heisei 18) nine cars had been added. The "14" in the type designation comes from its debut in Heisei 14.
Only cars 1 and 2 were built by Fuji Heavy Industries, but because that company withdrew from the railway vehicle business in 2003 (Heisei 15), cars 3 onward were built by Nippon Sharyo.
章节.Body:
While following the specifications of Fuji Heavy Industries' LE-DC, the body is an 18 m class two-door ordinary steel car with a front gangway door, aiming at further cost reduction by, for example, lining up fixed windows in a continuous-window style at the center of the sides, making the curvature of the roof structure a single type, and eliminating the curved glass of the front windows. The body structure made by Nippon Sharyo reduces cost and also seeks to reduce the vibration and noise peculiar to diesel railcars by using a structure with thicker outer panels and fewer ribs.
Headlights and tail lights are provided at the top of the front, and rearview mirrors for one-man operation are provided on both sides of the front windows.
For the livery, the upper part, evoking a bag, is a mosaic pattern of dark and light green (a checkered pattern; evoking fabric), the lower part is orange, and a thin white band (dashed line) imitating stitching is wound around the upper part of the orange paint (evoking leather). The design was decided based on a proposal solicited from the general public.
章节.Interior:
The air-conditioning outlets, unlike those of the conventional LE-DC, are continuous grilles aimed at cost reduction.
The seats are semi-cross seating (Fuji Heavy Industries make) or all-longitudinal seating (Nippon Sharyo make), and a digital fare display, a fare box with a change machine, and a numbered-ticket issuing machine are installed at the rear of the driver's cab.
章节.Equipment:
The running equipment is unified to locally made manufacturers: as the running engine, one Komatsu diesel engine SA6D125-H-1 (355 ps) is mounted, and the transmission is also the company's KTF3335A. The bogies are bolsterless bogies FU56D/T. Heating is of the hot-air type using the engine's cooling water.
Mooka 14-1 and 2 were fitted with ATS-P in preparation for through running onto JR lines, but it was never actually used, and cars 3 onward are not fitted with it.
章节.Differences by manufacturer:
The two Fuji Heavy Industries cars have the headlights and marker lights arranged together above the gangway door so that bulbs can be easily replaced from inside the car, whereas the seven Nippon Sharyo cars have them arranged separately above the left and right front windows, with the upper part of the gangway door being a small window for a "one-man operation light."
In addition, the two Fuji Heavy Industries cars differ in that, for cost reduction, the step at the lower front is only a simple one made of iron bars (a separate step was later added above it), and the side rain gutters are exposed to the outside, and so on.
When Mooka 14-1 and 2 began operation on January 20, 2002 (Heisei 14), due to repeated troubles such as failures of the in-car announcement device and air-conditioning system as well as electrical and control systems, operation was limited to daytime only, and at one point a person in charge from Fuji Heavy Industries rode along.
章节.Operation: As of November 2016 (Heisei 28), nine cars are in service, operating over the entire Mooka Line between Shimodate Station and Motegi Station. Normally they run as a single car (single-car operation), but they may be increased to two cars during weekday commuting and school hours. 英文.全文:
The Mooka Railway Mooka 14 series diesel railcar (もおかてつどうモオカ14がたきどうしゃ) is a diesel railcar of Mooka Railway that began commercial operation in 2002 (Heisei 14).

== Overview ==
The Mooka 63 series used since Mooka Railway opened was the LE-Car II series by Fuji Heavy Industries (now SUBARU), and because it made heavy use of bus parts with a shorter service life than railway vehicles, its aging with the passage of years had begun to stand out.
This series began to be produced from 2002 (Heisei 14) as a replacement for the Mooka 63 series, and by 2006 (Heisei 18) nine cars had been added. The "14" in the type designation comes from its debut in Heisei 14.
Only cars 1 and 2 were built by Fuji Heavy Industries, but because that company withdrew from the railway vehicle business in 2003 (Heisei 15), cars 3 onward were built by Nippon Sharyo.

== Structure ==

=== Body ===
While following the specifications of Fuji Heavy Industries' LE-DC, the body is an 18 m class two-door ordinary steel car with a front gangway door, aiming at further cost reduction by, for example, lining up fixed windows in a continuous-window style at the center of the sides, making the curvature of the roof structure a single type, and eliminating the curved glass of the front windows. The body structure made by Nippon Sharyo reduces cost and also seeks to reduce the vibration and noise peculiar to diesel railcars by using a structure with thicker outer panels and fewer ribs.
Headlights and tail lights are provided at the top of the front, and rearview mirrors for one-man operation are provided on both sides of the front windows.
For the livery, the upper part, evoking a bag, is a mosaic pattern of dark and light green (a checkered pattern; evoking fabric), the lower part is orange, and a thin white band (dashed line) imitating stitching is wound around the upper part of the orange paint (evoking leather). The design was decided based on a proposal solicited from the general public.

=== Interior ===
The air-conditioning outlets, unlike those of the conventional LE-DC, are continuous grilles aimed at cost reduction.
The seats are semi-cross seating (Fuji Heavy Industries make) or all-longitudinal seating (Nippon Sharyo make), and a digital fare display, a fare box with a change machine, and a numbered-ticket issuing machine are installed at the rear of the driver's cab.

=== Equipment ===
The running equipment is unified to locally made manufacturers: as the running engine, one Komatsu diesel engine SA6D125-H-1 (355 ps) is mounted, and the transmission is also the company's KTF3335A. The bogies are bolsterless bogies FU56D/T. Heating is of the hot-air type using the engine's cooling water.
Mooka 14-1 and 2 were fitted with ATS-P in preparation for through running onto JR lines, but it was never actually used, and cars 3 onward are not fitted with it.

=== Differences by manufacturer ===
The two Fuji Heavy Industries cars have the headlights and marker lights arranged together above the gangway door so that bulbs can be easily replaced from inside the car, whereas the seven Nippon Sharyo cars have them arranged separately above the left and right front windows, with the upper part of the gangway door being a small window for a "one-man operation light."
In addition, the two Fuji Heavy Industries cars differ in that, for cost reduction, the step at the lower front is only a simple one made of iron bars (a separate step was later added above it), and the side rain gutters are exposed to the outside, and so on.
When Mooka 14-1 and 2 began operation on January 20, 2002 (Heisei 14), due to repeated troubles such as failures of the in-car announcement device and air-conditioning system as well as electrical and control systems, operation was limited to daytime only, and at one point a person in charge from Fuji Heavy Industries rode along.

== Operation ==
As of November 2016 (Heisei 28), nine cars are in service, operating over the entire Mooka Line between Shimodate Station and Motegi Station. Normally they run as a single car (single-car operation), but they may be increased to two cars during weekday commuting and school hours. They also run as a three-car set when the Mooka City Summer Festival Grand Fireworks Display is held.
